title: 2011 AMC 8 Problem 6
statement: In a town of \(351\) adults, every adult owns a car, a motorcycle, or both. If \(331\) adults own cars and \(45\) adults own motorcycles, how many of the car owners do not own a motorcycle?

solutions.text:
We know that \(45\) people own motorcycles, so \(351 - 45 = 306\) people do not own motorcycles.

Thus, D is the correct answer.
hints: Subtract the motorcycle owners from the total adults.
The adults without motorcycles are exactly the car owners who do not own a motorcycle.
